description: This PHP script retrieves and outputs a configuration template for a code tracker type associated with a project. It initializes the page, processes request parameters, interacts with the tlCodeTracker class to get type information, and outputs a JSON-encoded array with configuration details or error messages.

classes.name: tlCodeTracker
classes.description: A class responsible for managing code tracker types and related functionalities.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of available code tracker types.

methods.name: getImplementationForType
methods.description: Returns the class name implementing a specific tracker type.
